description: This file contains unit tests for the Session class in the Goteo application's namespace. It uses PHPUnit to verify session management functionalities such as start, store, retrieve, delete, and expiration.

classes.name: SessionTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for testing basic session operations in the Goteo application.

methods.name: testInstance
methods.description: Tests instantiation of a Session object.

methods.name: testStore
methods.description: Tests storing a key-value pair in session and verifying existence and correctness.

methods.name: testRetrieve
methods.description: Tests retrieving a stored session value.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deletion of a session key and verifying its non-existence.

methods.name: testGetAndDelete
methods.description: Tests fetching a value and deleting it atomically.

methods.name: testDestroy
methods.description: Tests starting a session and storing data within that session.

methods.name: testExpire
methods.description: Tests session expiration by starting a session and storing data.
